connector.name: Off-Nadir Delta
connector.registryDescription: Live geolocated world-event intelligence and a Daily World Brief for AI agents.
connector.summary: Hosted at offnadir-delta.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.offnadir-delta, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer credential: an Off-Nadir Delta API key ("Bearer ond_...", issued self-serve at /account/api) or an OAuth 2.1 access token. The endpoint also advertises OAuth 2.1 (with Dynamic Client Registration) for interactive clients.
